g.text: Synthetic two-band light curves: SN Ia, II, Ib/c (Bazin-type profiles with class-dependent rise, decline, colour and secondary peak), AGN (damped random walk) and
periodic variables; 28–45 irregular epochs with noise. Random forest (200 trees, 15 features); 6 000 training and 3 000 test objects. Seed 5152.
